summary: In Step 1, I tapped the 'Log In' button marked in red on the welcome screen of the EVIA application. The screen remained visually unchanged, still displaying the 'Welcome to Evia!' header, the 'Get Started' button, the 'Log In' button, and the 'Explore as Guest' link at the bottom. No new modal, page transition, or input field appeared following the interaction, and the interface elements remained in their original positions as seen before the tap.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Log In' button on the welcome screen, which transitioned the view to the login page; I then typed '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]' into the 'Email address' field. The screen now displays 'Welcome back!', the populated email field, an empty 'Password' field with a visibility toggle, a 'Log in' button, a 'Continue with Google' option, and a 'Sign up' link, with the system keyboard visible at the bottom of the display.

In Step 3, I tapped the 'Password' input field and entered '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. The field now displays a series of masked characters ending in '9', while the 'Log in' button remains below the field. The email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' is still visible in the field above, and the on-screen keyboard remains active at the bottom of the display.

In Step 4, I tapped the 'Done' button on the keyboard, which was marked in red on the screen. Following this action, the keyboard disappeared from view, revealing the full 'Welcome back!' login interface. The 'Log in' button now displays a blue loading indicator, while the email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' and the masked password field remain populated. The 'Forgot password?', 'Continue with Google', and 'Sign up' options are also visible on the screen, and the top of the display now shows a 'Skip' button.

In Step 5, I tapped the 'Log in' button marked in red on the login screen; the display transitioned to an event details page titled '[DEMO] Định hướng nghề nghiệp lập trình'. This new screen displays event information including '77 spots left', the organizer '[DEMO] CLB Công nghệ Evia', the date 'Nov 8, 2026', and the time '13:10'. A 'Register Now' button is visible at the bottom of the screen, and there is a back arrow icon in the top-left corner along with a bookmark icon in the top-right corner.

In Step 6, I tapped the 'Back' arrow icon located at the top left of the event details screen. The display transitioned to the main 'Discover' tab, which shows the greeting 'Hey EVIA E2E!', a balance of '200 coins', and a search bar. The screen now features a carousel with the event '[DEMO] Workshop Flutter đang mở check-in' and a 'Recommended for You' section. The bottom navigation bar remains visible, highlighting the 'Discover' tab with a blue indicator dot beneath the icon.

In Step 7, I tapped the 'Events' tab icon in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'My Events' page, which displays 'Upcoming 0' and 'Past 0' tabs, a calendar view for the week of November 2 to November 8, 2026, and a message stating 'No events on this date' with a 'Show all events' button below it. The bottom navigation bar now highlights the 'Events' tab, while the 'Discover', 'Rewards', and 'Profile' tabs remain visible alongside it.

In Step 8, I tapped the 'Rewards' tab marked in red on the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned from the 'My Events' view to the 'Rewards' page. The new screen displays 'Available Coins' of 200, a 'View coin history' link, and a 'Daily Check-in' section featuring a '1-day streak' badge and a 'Check In +5 coins' button. The bottom navigation bar now shows the 'Rewards' icon highlighted, while the 'Discover', 'Events', and 'Profile' tabs remain visible alongside it.

In Step 9, I tapped the 'Profile' tab icon marked in red on the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Profile' page, which displays the user name 'EVIA E2E', ID 'SE990001', and email '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. The page includes an 'Edit Profile' button, a 'YOUR ACTIVITY' section with 'Saved Events', 'Following', and 'Notifications' options, and a 'PREFERENCES & SUPPORT' section containing 'My Interests' and 'App Settings'. The bottom navigation bar now highlights the 'Profile' tab as the active selection, confirming the transition from the previous 'Rewards' screen.
